messages.author: edd4914c326b6d31
messages.subject: rstan: traceplot fails
parts:
Using development code:
a1 is a stanfit object created by running parallel chains and combining
the results with sflist2stanfit().
> traceplot(a1, pars="sigma")
Error in xy.coords(x, y) : 'x' and 'y' lengths differ
> traceplot(a1)
Error in xy.coords(x, y) : 'x' and 'y' lengths differ
> class(a1)
[1] "stanfit"
attr(,"package")
[1] "rstan"


I was able to get the model I posted previously with the poisson_log
to run after removing the truncation. The results were disastrous:
> summary(summary(a1)$summary[, c('n_eff', 'Rhat')])
n_eff Rhat
Min. : 1.500 Min. :1.000e+00
1st Qu.: 1.528 1st Qu.:2.000e+00
Median : 1.692 Median :3.000e+00
Mean : 64.896 Mean :7.519e+11
3rd Qu.: 2.064 3rd Qu.:7.000e+00
Max. :5250.000 Max. :9.308e+14

Using Sean's trick--thanks!
These were from combining 3 chains of 4000 each, 500 warmup, thin 2.
Oddly, the trial run with 200 iterations appeared to work kind of OK.
Some inspection of the results suggest at least some chains and
parameters got stuck.

I'll try Daniel's suggestion for the truncation (yes, I was using the
log parameterization), but I suspect the problem lies elsewhere. In
particular, this model has an intercept which probably is relatively
large (like 2) and not mean centered. I treated this as another beta
parameter normal(0, sigma) but I let sigma be estimated from the data
for that one parameter. I'll deal with that when I'm more awake.
